setting.enigma.java.home: Installation directory of the Java runtime (17 or newer) that runs the Enigma engine. When empty, a suitable one is found automatically: `JAVA_HOME`, then `java` on the `PATH`, then the JDKs installed in the usual places, skipping any that are too old. Use the command **Enigma: Select Java Runtime...** to pick one from a list.
setting.enigma.java.vmArgs: Extra arguments for the Java virtual machine running the Enigma engine, for example `-Xmx4G` for very large jars.
setting.enigma.profile: Path to an Enigma profile JSON file configuring services (indexers, name proposers, obfuscation tests) and mapping save parameters. When empty, Enigma's default profile is used.
setting.enigma.pluginJars: Jars of Enigma plugins to load. They are added to the engine's classpath and discovered through `META-INF/services/org.quiltmc.enigma.api.EnigmaPlugin`, exactly like in Enigma.
setting.enigma.libraries: Library jars the opened jar depends on. They improve decompilation and inheritance analysis, but are not shown or mapped.
setting.enigma.decompiler: The decompiler used to show classes.
setting.enigma.vineflower: Options passed to the Vineflower decompiler, by option key. See <https://vineflower.org/usage/>.
setting.enigma.editable: What may be edited. Equivalent to Enigma's `--edit-*` and `--no-edit-*` command line options.
setting.enigma.autoSaveMappings: Save mappings automatically after every change.
setting.enigma.reopenLastProject: What to do, when a window is opened, with the jar and mappings that were open in it the last time.
setting.enigma.reopenLastProject.never: Do not reopen it. It stays in "Open Recent Project...".
setting.enigma.maxRecentProjects: How many recently opened projects are remembered.
setting.enigma.references.maxClasses: Maximum number of classes that are decompiled to answer a single "Find All References" request.
setting.enigma.stats.includeSynthetic: Count synthetic entries in mapping statistics.
setting.enigma.stats.countFallback: Count entries with fallback proposed names as mapped in mapping statistics.
setting.enigma.notifications.server: Which collaboration events are announced in the status bar while the Collaboration pane is hidden.
setting.enigma.notifications.server.full: People joining and leaving, and chat messages
setting.enigma.editor.inlineRename: Rename by typing over the highlighted names in decompiled classes. Everything else in a class stays protected. When disabled, classes are read-only and names are changed with **Rename Symbol** (F2) or in the Identifier pane.
setting.enigma.editor.replaceObfuscatedN: When typing on a name that is still obfuscated, replace it instead of adding to it, like Enigma does. Names that were already given are edited normally.
setting.enigma.classTree.compactPackages: Show packages that only contain another package as one entry, like com.example.
setting.enigma.classTree.mode: How the classes of a jar are listed in the Enigma side bar.
setting.enigma.classTree.mode.split: Two trees: the classes that still have their obfuscated name, and the ones that were given a name.
setting.enigma.layout.revealPanes: Show the Identifier pane (bottom) and the Structure pane (right) when the first class of a jar is opened, if they are hidden.
setting.enigma.mcp.enabled: Let assistants outside the editor, such as Claude Code, work on the jar that is open, over the Model Context Protocol. They connect to this window on this machine only, with a token: run **Enigma: Connect an Assistant over MCP...** to get what they need. The chat of the editor itself does not need this.
setting.enigma.mcp.port: The port on this machine that the MCP server listens on. One window at a time can have it.
color.enigma.obfuscatedBackground: Background of names that have no mapping.
color.enigma.obfuscatedBorder: Outline of names that have no mapping.
color.enigma.deobfuscatedBackground: Background of names that were mapped manually or read from a mappings file.
color.enigma.deobfuscatedBorder: Outline of names that were mapped manually or read from a mappings file.
color.enigma.proposedBackground: Background of names that were proposed automatically by a plugin.
color.enigma.proposedBorder: Outline of names that were proposed automatically by a plugin.
color.enigma.fallbackBackground: Background of low-quality fallback names proposed by a plugin.
color.enigma.fallbackBorder: Outline of low-quality fallback names proposed by a plugin.
color.enigma.debugBackground: Background of tokens highlighted for debugging.
color.enigma.debugBorder: Outline of tokens highlighted for debugging.
color.enigma.editingBackground: Background of the occurrences of a name while it is being typed.
color.enigma.editingBorder: Outline of the occurrences of a name while it is being typed.
extension.description: Deobfuscate Java bytecode with the Enigma engine: decompile jars, rename classes, methods, fields and parameters, and manage mappings.
